notes.title: Bugs found, bugs fixed
notes.notes:
This new patch includes changes to the main menu to make it more visually appealing, as well as some bug fixes that made it difficult to play DO NOT OPEN correctly, for example: the sudoku puzzle was coming out too bright. 

Remember that we are very grateful if you can tell us about any bugs you find and/or ways to improve the game.

Best regards and happy holidays! 🎅

notes.title: New update!
notes.notes:
We have fixed some minor bugs that, although they did not prevent the game from running smoothly, could cause confusion. For example: we have fixed a furniture that, when opening its doors, you could still see other doors underneath.

We have also made the maze puzzle easier by increasing the number of errors required and improving the physics.

We will keep working on improving your experience!

notes.title: NEW UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The development team has just released a new update where you can find some improvements and some bug fixes!
We are still working on providing you with the best possible experience :).
[h2] Changes in the 14.12.2022 version[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added option to exit to the desktop😳  
[*] Adjusted collisions to make it easier to interact with objects inside drawers.
[*] Activated siren sound in the lab.
[*] Floating objects in some areas removed.
[*] Fixed a bug where time would not stop.
[*] Some texts have been translated, initially in Spanish.
[*] Some sounds were being triggered twice.
[*] If subtitles were set to OFF, no help messages were displayed.
[*] Added VSYNC option.
[*] Updated certain meshes according to the time (20 minutes).
[*] Some languages didn't support special characters.

[h2] You might like this [/h2]
[list]
[*] The maze has been simplified by flattening its surface.
[*] Enemy is now easier to dodge due to reduced speed.
[/list]
[/list]

That said... Let's play!

notes.title: DO NOT OPEN now available for download!
notes.notes:
[h1]It's not going to be easy, be warned[/h1].

[b]Do Not Open[/b] is a terrifying experience designed to push your nerves and your problem-solving skills to the limit. Plus, you'll have to try to survive the torment that will haunt you if you give yourself away by taking too long or getting puzzles wrong. 

[h1]ONLY FOR THOSE LOOKING FOR STRONG EMOTIONS [/h1]

A [i]survival horror[/i], with [i]scape room[/i] mechanics and in a terrifying and oppressive environment, Michael J. Goreng, a famous American zoologist and epidemiologist, is trapped in a deformed version of his own house. He doesn't understand why, but he knows he must escape the place by any means necessary because he senses something evil lurking behind every step he takes. 

[h2]How can that be? [/h2]

Julia and Anne, his wife and daughter, are in great danger and getting out of there is key. But the house has not made this task easy for him and he will have to do his best to achieve it. 

In addition to all of this, [b]Do Not Open[/b] is designed to be fully replayable and no game will be identical to the previous one. The Goreng house doesn't want you to leave. Each new game involves a different layout and variety of rooms. With each death, the locations of key items and solutions to puzzles change randomly. [u]Everything is similar to what you already know but nothing is the same[/u].

[h2]RESOLVE, HIDE OR DIE![/h2]
